summary: ​An interactive Earth observation prototype that makes environmental science accessible and multi-sensory by combining visual satellite data with dynamic audio sonification. Using advanced NASA EMIT data, it explores and monitors Earth's biomes. Developed as a passionate student project bridging space science, data, and technology to inspire public curiosity.
details: Project Overview & How It Works: ITEWTSE (It's Easy Way to Study Earth) is an interactive Earth observation prototype that transforms complex environmental data into an engaging, multi-sensory experience. Users can explore diverse global biomes—ranging from polar regions like Antarctica to tropical rainforests like the Amazon—by combining visual Earth observation data with dynamic audio sonification. ​Benefits & Intended Impact: Scientific satellite data is often difficult for students and the general public to interpret. By translating environmental indicators into sound and interactive visuals, ITEWTSE makes Earth science accessible, intuitive, and inclusive—especially for learners who benefit from auditory and multi-sensory engagement. ​Tools, Data & Creativity: The project utilizes real open-source Earth science datasets from NASA's EMIT (Earth Surface Mineral Dust Source Investigation) mission. It was designed as a conceptual front-end prototype focusing on user-friendly educational storytelling, connecting planetaryobservation optics with human sensory perception to inspire curiosity about climate and Earth's ecosystems.
